title: 29101 - 29101/U0429/050217
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Missing or Invalid Message from Steering Column Kontrol Modülü (J527 / #16)
Fault Code(s) stored in Steering Column Kontrol Modülü (J527 / #16)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Steering Column Kontrol Modülü (J527 / #16) for Fault Code(s)
technicalNotes: This Fault Code does not contain any Information on what the actual Problem may be, instead it indicates that another Kontrol Modülü (in this case the Steering Column Kontrol Modülü) may provide further Details. If no Fault Codes are stored in the Steering Column Kontrol Modülü this Fault Code can be ignored but you should Kontrol edin: if it comes back - eventually in Combination with Fault Codes in the Steering Column Kontrol Modülü.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
